title: Area: Sunderland
content:
Online GCSE science tuition, anywhere in England and Wales

Online GCSE science tuition for students in Sunderland — live, taught sessions with a former Head of Science. Taught by Rod Martin — an expert science tutor and former Head of Science with over twenty years in UK classrooms.

Science tuition around Sunderland

Sunderland sits at the mouth of the Wear on the North East coast, south of Newcastle and with its own city schools and college provision.

Confidence is often the thing to rebuild first. A student who has decided they are 'not a science person' will not revise, and no amount of content helps until that sentence stops being true.

Three ways to work together

Whichever suits the student in front of me — not whichever is easiest to sell.
